sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CombinedShutouts WHERE year = 1977 AND `R/P` = 'R'
SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM Goalies WHERE year = 2005 AND ENG IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.coachID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.w > 30 AND T1.birthCountry = 'USA'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.award FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.birthYear = 1952
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.coachID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T2.year = 1940 AND T1.birthCity = 'Toronto'
SELECT firstName FROM Master WHERE shootCatch = 'B' AND pos = 'G' AND hofID IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT T1.birthCity FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 1970
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.birthCity = 'Toronto' AND T2.award = 'All-Rookie'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.playerID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.deathState = 'MA'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.nameNick FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.award = 'All-Rookie' AND T1.birthMon = 3
SELECT T1.birthYear FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.birthYear ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.birthCountry FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsPlayers AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID GROUP BY T1.playerID ORDER BY COUNT(T2.award) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT W FROM Goalies WHERE playerID = 'vanbijo01' AND year = 1990
SELECT T1.w FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.year = 1933 AND T2.award = 'Second Team All-Star'

SELECT T4.birthCountry FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN Coaches AS T3 ON T1.year = T3.year AND T1.tmID = T3.tmID AND T3.coachID != T1.coachID INNER JOIN Master AS T4 ON T3.coachID = T4.coachID WHERE T2.firstName = 'Dave' AND T2.lastName = 'Lewis' AND T1.year = 1998
SELECT T1.shootCatch FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2010 ORDER BY T2.SHO DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year = 2002 AND T2.GA > 150 ORDER BY T1.birthYear DESC, T1.birthMon DESC, T1.birthDay DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.tmID = 'NJD' GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.SA) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.name FROM Goalies AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2010 GROUP BY T2.tmID, T2.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.PostENG) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT GP FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'broadpu01' AND year = 1922
SELECT G FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'dyeba01' AND year = 1921
SELECT DISTINCT pos FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID = 'hartgi01'
SELECT BenchMinor, name FROM Teams ORDER BY T DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(PPG AS REAL) * 100 / PPC FROM Teams ORDER BY L DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE shootCatch = 'B' AND firstNHL = 2011
SELECT DISTINCT T2.coachID, T2.award FROM AwardsCoaches AS T2 WHERE T2.coachID = (SELECT coachID FROM Coaches ORDER BY w DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT T1.nameGiven FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.year BETWEEN 2003 AND 2005 AND T2.PIM BETWEEN 200 AND 250 ORDER BY T2.GP DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.award, T2.firstName, T2.lastName FROM AwardsPlayers AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.pos = (SELECT pos FROM AwardsPlayers GROUP BY pos ORDER BY COUNT(award) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY T1.year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.oppID), T2.name, T3.name FROM TeamVsTeam AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.oppID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T1.year = 1915 AND T1.tmID = (SELECT tmID FROM Teams WHERE year = 1915 ORDER BY W DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T3.name
SELECT T2.rank, T2.year, T2.name FROM Scoring AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.SHA >= 7 ORDER BY T1.A DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(tmID) FROM Teams WHERE year = 2006 AND W > L AND Pts > 100
SELECT name FROM Teams WHERE year = 1995 AND name IN ('Florida Panthers', 'Edmonton Oilers', 'Los Angeles Kings') ORDER BY PKC DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.W FROM TeamVsTeam AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.oppID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T1.year = 1985 AND T2.name = 'Philadelphia Flyers' AND T3.name = 'Boston Bruins'

SELECT T3.name FROM TeamVsTeam AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.oppID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T1.year = 2000 AND T2.name = 'Buffalo Sabres' GROUP BY T3.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.W + T1.L + IFNULL(T1.T, 0) + IFNULL(T1.OTL, 0)) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.PIM FROM TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.year = 1918
SELECT T2.W FROM TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.PIM = 24
SELECT CAST(SUM(T1.W) AS REAL) / SUM(T1.G) FROM TeamsSC AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.birthCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.coachID) FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Teams AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year INNER JOIN Master AS T3 ON T1.coachID = T3.coachID WHERE T2.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE lastName = 'Green' AND playerID IS NOT NULL AND coachID IS NULL
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T2.ENG = 10 ORDER BY T1.height DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.tmID) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.lastName = 'Young'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.coachID IS NOT NULL AND T1.hofID IS NOT NULL AND T2.year = 1972 AND T2.tmID = 'BOS'

SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T2.tmID = T3.tmID AND T2.year = T3.year WHERE T3.name = 'Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.GA) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.stint = 1 THEN T2.GP ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.stint = 2 THEN T2.GP ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.stint = 1 THEN T2.GP ELSE 0 END) FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Goalies AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID WHERE T1.firstName = 'David' AND T1.lastName = 'Aebischer' AND T2.year = 2005
SELECT playerID FROM Master GROUP BY playerID HAVING AVG(height) = 75
SELECT playerID FROM Master ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT playerID FROM Master WHERE deathYear IS NOT NULL AND playerID IS NOT NULL
SELECT DISTINCT T1.coachID FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN AwardsCoaches AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID WHERE T1.playerID IS NULL
SELECT SUM(T1.Pts), T2.coachID FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.tmID = 'ANA' GROUP BY T2.coachID
